name: Change The Future
findings: Counters basic Ki Blasts and Ki Blast skills during its active window, then moves toward the attacker and fires a Ki Blast
The follow-up has i-frames and cannot be interrupted; the blast does not break guard or hyper armor
Startup visually matches God Breaker and dedicated documentation describes lower endlag
PQ43 — Change The Future lists the skill in Basic Reward
The in-game description says Strike Attack, while the documented mechanics identify Ki Blast triggers; this text discrepancy is retained
Exact active-frame count, endlag, damage, and drop probability remain unresolved
